acceptance: ADR-028 defines the schema-owner gate, released snapshots, migrations, deprecation, rollback and promotion conditions with rejected-change examples, and the compat checker enforces them against the released snapshot in CI.

positive.fixture: the working schemas are compatible with released 1.0.0; additive changes pass with a minor bump

negative.fixture: 15 breaking changes are rejected without a major bump and 6 additive changes without a version bump

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
performance_memory_storage: Compat check compares IDL definitions only; runs in under a second.
known_limitations: CODEOWNERS enforcement needs branch protection requiring code owner review
